## Summary

What user problem does this change solve, and what behavior changed?

## Risk areas

- [ ] UI only
- [ ] Geometry or stable identity
- [ ] Project schema or persistence
- [ ] PDF, STL, 3MF, packing, or fabrication ZIP
- [ ] Manufacturing claim or physical qualification

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Browser behavior and console checked where relevant
- [ ] `npm run sample` and nine-family export validator run where relevant
- [ ] Representative slicer check performed where relevant
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Schema and `GEOMETRY_ALGORITHM_VERSION` impact reviewed

Describe any intentionally skipped check and why.
